toast.switch_success: Wrote {{email}} and started Antigravity. Confirm the signed-in account in the app.

flow.quick_desc: Connect Google directly, or open import tools when you already have credentials.
flow.advanced_desc: Choose a source, preview accounts, then confirm the import.
flow.oauth_desc: Authorize in your system browser. AMT receives the callback and adds the account automatically.
flow.oauth_waiting_hint: Choose an account and finish authorization in your browser. AMT will continue automatically.
flow.oauth_processing_hint: Browser callback received. Please keep this window open until it finishes.
flow.oauth_failed: Authorization failed. Check the browser and try again.
flow.oauth_no_refresh: Long-term authorization was not granted. Revoke the previous grant and retry.
flow.browser_failed: Could not open the browser. Copy the authorization link and open it manually.
flow.not_switched: Adding an account does not sign out or switch your current account.
flow.copy_failed: Could not copy the link. Try again.
flow.manual_placeholder: Paste the callback URL or code
flow.manual_hint: Only use this if the browser did not return to AMT. The result will still finish automatically.
flow.manual_failed: Manual submission failed. Check the callback or restart authorization.
flow.cancel_failed: Could not cancel. Close this window and try again.
flow.finish_processing: An account is being processed. Wait for the result before closing or switching.
flow.local_desc: Read signed-in credentials, verify identity, preview results, and select accounts to add.
flow.local_preview_hint: Scanning does not save accounts in AMT or change your current account.
flow.local_empty: No local account was found. Sign in to Antigravity or use another import method.
flow.local_summary: Import finished: {{imported}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed. Current account unchanged.
flow.local_row_failed: Credential could not be verified. Sign in again in Antigravity, then rescan.
flow.scan_security: Scan results last only for this dialog. Credentials are never shown here.
flow.scan_failed: Scan failed. Check local sign-in and try again.
flow.import_failed: Import failed. Scan again and retry.
flow.token_desc: Paste one or more tokens or load a JSON account backup. Duplicates are removed and each result is shown.
flow.token_placeholder: One 1//… token per line, or JSON containing refresh_token
flow.json_loaded: JSON backup loaded. Review it before importing.
flow.token_row_failed: Item {{index}} · Failed; you can retry it
flow.invalid_json: Invalid JSON. Check the file content.
flow.invalid_token: No valid token found. Use the complete 1//… format.
flow.token_security: Tokens are sensitive. Input is cleared after import; results and logs never show tokens.
flow.legacy_desc: Use only for older AMT data or a selected database.
flow.custom_db_desc: Preview available accounts before confirming the import.
flow.v1_desc: Import all accounts from the legacy backup directory. Existing accounts with the same email may be updated.
flow.v1_confirm_desc: This reads the legacy backup and may update credentials for matching emails. The current account will not change.
flow.legacy_summary: Imported {{count}} legacy accounts. Current account unchanged.
flow.legacy_failed: Legacy import failed. Check the backup directory.
flow.file_failed: Could not read the file. Check its format and permissions.

dialog.batch_warmup_msg: Are you sure you want to trigger warmup for the selected {{count}} accounts immediately?

general.title: General Settings
general.auto_launch_desc: Automatically launch AMT when system starts
general.auto_check_update_desc: Automatically check for new versions on startup
general.update_check_interval_desc: Checks only at startup; enter 1–168 hours, then save
general.update_check_interval_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 168

account.title: Account Settings
account.auto_refresh_desc: Automatically refresh all account quotas in the background. This is required for quota protection and smart warmup.
account.auto_sync_desc: Automatically sync current active account information periodically

warmup.title: 7-Day Weekly Reset Warmup
warmup.desc: Sends one lightweight request after the selected model's seven-day quota resets to start the new cycle.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.default_export_path_desc: Open this folder by default when exporting; confirm the file name and location each time
advanced.data_dir_desc: Where accounts, settings, and logs are stored. Choosing a new folder migrates data and cleans up the old one.
advanced.data_dir_migrate_msg: All data will be moved to: {{path}}
advanced.data_dir_restart_hint: Restart the app so log files that were in use fully switch to the new folder
advanced.migrate_desc: Migrate all current data (including accounts, configs, request logs, and databases) to a new location.
advanced.migrate_clean_source: Clean source directory after migration (Free up disk space)
advanced.migrate_restart_notice: The app will automatically restart after migration to load the new data directory.
advanced.antigravity_path_desc: If you installed Antigravity in a non-standard location, you can manually specify the executable path here (Points to .app on MacOS).
advanced.antigravity_args_desc: Specify startup arguments for Antigravity, e.g. --user-data-dir to specify user data directory
advanced.page_size_desc: Set the number of accounts displayed per page. Select 'Auto Calculate' to dynamically adjust based on window size.
advanced.logs_desc: Clear log cache files. Does not affect account data.
advanced.clear_logs_msg: Are you sure you want to clear all log cache files?
advanced.antigravity_cache_desc: Clear Antigravity cache to resolve login failures, version validation errors, and OAuth authorization issues.
advanced.antigravity_cache_warning: Please ensure Antigravity is completely closed before clearing cache.
advanced.clear_cache_confirm_msg: The following cache directories will be cleared:
advanced.debug_logs_enable_desc: When enabled, records the complete request and response chain. Recommended to enable only when troubleshooting issues.
advanced.debug_logs_desc: Records the full chain: original input, transformed v1internal request, and upstream response. For troubleshooting only, may contain sensitive data.
advanced.debug_log_dir_hint: Leave empty to use the default directory: {{path}}/debug_logs
advanced.http_api_desc: Provides local HTTP interface for external programs (e.g. VS Code plugins).
advanced.http_api_enabled_desc: When enabled, external programs can manage accounts via HTTP interface
advanced.http_api_port_desc: Restart required after changing port. If port conflict occurs, please use another available port.
advanced.http_api_settings_saved: HTTP API settings saved, restart required to apply

debug.title: Debug Console
debug.desc: View real-time application logs for debugging
debug.disabled_desc: Enable to start recording application logs
debug.console_desc: View real-time application logs to troubleshoot issues.
debug.enable_desc: Enable to capture and display backend logs.
debug.debug_logging_desc: When enabled, records the complete request and response chain. Recommended to enable only when troubleshooting issues.

network_proxy.title: Outbound Network Proxy
network_proxy.desc: When enabled, AMT routes external requests such as token refresh, quota queries, and update checks through this proxy.
network_proxy.desc_short: Used only for AMT's outbound connections to Google, GitHub, and related services.
network_proxy.socks5h_hint: If your proxy requires remote DNS resolution, use the socks5h:// protocol.

network_proxy.restart_hint: Proxy settings saved. Restart the app to apply changes.
